title: Codebook and prompts for zero-shot behavior detection of group interaction with vision-language models
description:
Supplementary materials of the paper Observing Group Interaction in the Physical Workspace: Zero-Shot Behavior Detection with Vision-Language Models.

The repository contains (1) the behavior codebook used by the human annotators and the vision-language models, with the coding scheme, the unitizing rules, and the annotation principles, and (2) the structured system and user prompts with which the models (Qwen3.5-397B, Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.5-9B) were applied zero-shot to video recordings of small-group decision making at a shared touchscreen.
